result:
I've fixed all three findings (F-DG1-003, -004, -005) in the web app. Typecheck, lint, build, the no-CDN check and all 92 web tests pass. The real-stack e2e journeys are **BLOCKED**: I didn't start the API/DB stack, as the assignment asked, so the reviewers will run them. The changes are uncommitted in the worktree, and none of the findings is closed; that's for the reviewers.

**F-DG1-003: Arabic terms now follow the glossary** (`docs/analysis/glossary.md`, the DG0 deliverable)
- "Transformation" is now التحوّل / التحوّلات everywhere: list, detail, create, edit, breadcrumbs, admin scope type, nav, error messages and My Work. Initiative (مبادرة) is now a separate term.
- Other terms now match the glossary:

  | Term | Old | Now |
  |---|---|---|
  | End-to-End mode | متكامل من البداية إلى النهاية | النمط الشامل (من البداية إلى النهاية) |
  | Modular mode | معياري | النمط الجزئي المرن (الدخول عند المرحلة المناسبة) |
  | Phase 5 (Transform) | التحول | التحويل والتنفيذ |
  | North Star | نجم الشمال | النجم الشمالي (الغاية العليا) |
  | Playbook name | دليل التحول المؤسسي | دليل تحوّل الأعمال |
  | BAU | التشغيل المعتاد | العمليات الاعتيادية |

- Status labels changed to masculine (نشط، مغلق…) to agree with the new noun.
- English strings already matched the glossary, so they're unchanged.
- A new test reads the glossary file directly and checks the catalogue terms against it, including that Transformation and Initiative stay different.

**F-DG1-004: no dead "Not found" after create**
- After creating, the detail page loads the record from the server.
- If the server refuses it (403 or 404), the creator sees a message in their language: "Transformation created, but you cannot open it", the code and name, that it was saved as a draft and not submitted or approved, and to ask an access administrator for access. There's a link back to the list.
- Other 403/404 cases still show the existing no-permission and not-found messages.
- I also changed one behaviour: a 403/404 on refresh now replaces the cached record instead of leaving it on screen marked "Stale".
- Whether the creator actually lands on the record depends on the backend fix F-DG1-106. I tested both server answers with a mocked API only.

**F-DG1-005: audit trail in plain language**
- Field names, statuses, modes, phases, user names, business units and dates in the "Changes" column now show localized labels in both languages.
- An empty value shows "None / لا يوجد" instead of ∅.
- Fields or values with no translation show the raw key, clearly marked "(field without a translation)" / "(حقل بلا ترجمة)" or "(value without a translation)" / "(قيمة بلا ترجمة)", never blank.

**Tests and evidence**
- I added 26 tests, covering Arabic and English. Run against the old code, 15 of them fail, so they do catch the old strings and behaviour.
- I took 12 Playwright screenshots (6 screens × EN and AR) of the built app against a mocked API. axe found no accessibility violations on any of them. I checked several myself: the Arabic layout mirrors correctly and the longer glossary labels wrap without overflowing.

**Still open**
- The round-1 Arabic screenshots in `apps/web/e2e/screenshots/` show the old terms until the next real-stack e2e run regenerates them.
- The glossary's Arabic terms still need review by a Mobily Arabic-language owner, as the glossary itself says.
- Untracked dotfiles and `CLAUDE.local.md` in the worktree root aren't from this task and shouldn't be integrated.

No dependency changes were needed. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG1/round-2/T-DG1-FE2-frontend-ux-engineer.md`. Screenshots and the capture script are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG1/round-2/T-DG1-FE2-evidence/`.
